content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Fonts online

When a country is restricted by a payment processor like Stripe, it's not because of the country itself, but because of the way that country's government regulates foreign companies. This means that even if you're a legitimate business, you might not be able to access the payment services you need to sell your products. But this isn't a problem of the country's restrictions - it's a problem of the payment processor's [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]. And the Edge Commerce Stack is designed to fix this by giving you a sovereign commerce solution that's not tied to any single platform or country.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack is built on top of Cloudflare Pages, which provides a fast and secure way to host your website. But what really sets it apart is the use of Cloudflare Workers, which allow you to run custom code on the edge of the Cloudflare network. This means that you can access and update your data in real-time, without having to rely on a centralized database. And because Cloudflare Workers are serverless, you don't have to worry about scaling or maintaining the underlying infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Edge Commerce Stack is built for digital creators who need a way to sell their products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any other payment processor. Whether you're a font designer, an ebook author, or a software developer, this solution is designed to give you the flexibility and control you need to succeed. And because it's built on a sovereign commerce architecture, you can rest assured that your business is protected from the risks of relying on a single platform or country.
You can own your commerce infrastructure and design it with your customers in mind.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack is made up of several key components, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Pages provides a fast and secure way to host your website, while Cloudflare Workers allow you to run custom code on the edge of the Cloudflare network. Supabase is a database that provides a scalable and secure way to store your data, while NOWPayments is a payment processor that allows you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Together, these components work together to provide a seamless and secure commerce experience for your customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the Edge Commerce Stack today, you can start by signing up for a Cloudflare account and setting up a new project. From there, you can use the Cloudflare Pages dashboard to create a new site and configure the necessary settings. Next, you can use the Cloudflare Workers dashboard to create a new worker and configure the necessary code. Finally, you can use the Supabase dashboard to set up a new database and configure the necessary settings. And with NOWPayments, you can start accepting cryptocurrency payments from your customers today.
